title: Ai and the first reverse
english: We beg hearers not to chase the bare letter with unbelieving readers. After Jericho Jesus sends a few against Ai; they turn their backs. Sin is in the camp: Achan has stolen from the ban. Until it is purged, the people cannot stand before enemies.
translator_notes: Copy-text Baehrens GCS 30 / Origenes Werke VII (1921), Rufinus Latin.
True OET: no ANF; do not copy Bruce FOTC 105 (Joshua).

title: Achan’s confession and judgment
english: The lot reveals Achan; he confesses: [[I saw a cloak, silver, gold >> Bible:Joshua 7:21]]. He is stoned with his — one man’s sin wounds the people. Camp purified, Jesus leads again to Ai.
translator_notes: Copy-text Baehrens GCS 30 / Origenes Werke VII (1921), Rufinus Latin.
True OET: no ANF; do not copy Bruce FOTC 105 (Joshua).

title: King of Ai on the twin wood
english: [[The king of Ai is hanged on a twin wood >> Bible:Joshua 8:29]] — a cross figure. The enemy prince is triumphed over on the tree; Christ [[disarms principalities on the cross >> Bible:Colossians 2:15]]. At evening the hanged form is taken down — the time of the economy.
translator_notes: Copy-text Baehrens GCS 30 / Origenes Werke VII (1921), Rufinus Latin.
True OET: no ANF; do not copy Bruce FOTC 105 (Joshua).

title: Ambush and the extended spear
english: [[Jesus stretches out the spear and does not draw it back until Ai is destroyed >> Bible:Joshua 8:18-26]]. Prayer and mind’s intent hold to victory’s end. He burns Ai — chaos of malice in the mind. Glory forever. Amen.
translator_notes: Copy-text Baehrens GCS 30 / Origenes Werke VII (1921), Rufinus Latin.
True OET: no ANF; do not copy Bruce FOTC 105 (Joshua).
